mapper.sql: left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = a.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_account acc on acc.id = a.member_id and acc.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset af on af.id = mp.avatar_file_id and af.is_delete = 0
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.application_no as applicationNo, a.member_id as memberId, mp.nickname as nickname, acc.email as email, af.access_url as avatarUrl, a.game_terminal as gameTerminal, a.game_account as gameAccount, a.position_code as positionCode, a.application_status as applicationStatus, a.submitted_time as submittedTime, a.reviewed_time as reviewedTime from basket_player_cert_application a
where a.is_delete = 0 and a.application_no like concat('%', #{applicationNo}, '%') and mp.nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') and acc.email like concat('%', #{email}, '%') and a.game_account like concat('%', #{gameAccount}, '%') and a.application_status = #{applicationStatus} and a.member_id = #{memberId} order by a.submitted_time desc, a.create_time desc

select a.id, a.id as applicationId, a.application_no as applicationNo, a.member_id as memberId, mp.nickname as nickname, acc.email as email, af.access_url as avatarUrl, a.game_terminal as gameTerminal, a.game_account as gameAccount, a.game_nickname as gameNickname, a.position_code as positionCode, a.application_status as applicationStatus, a.review_remark as reviewRemark, a.submitted_time as submittedTime, a.reviewed_time as reviewedTime, a.current_auditor_id as currentAuditorId from basket_player_cert_application a
where a.id = #{id} and a.is_delete = 0

select id, application_no, member_id, player_id, application_type, game_terminal, game_account, normalized_game_account, game_nickname, position_code, application_status, submitted_time, reviewed_time, current_auditor_id, review_remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_player_cert_application where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select id, application_no, member_id, player_id, application_type, game_terminal, game_account, normalized_game_account, game_nickname, position_code, application_status, submitted_time, reviewed_time, current_auditor_id, review_remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_player_cert_application where member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0 order by submitted_time desc, create_time desc
mapper.update: update basket_player_cert_application set application_status = #{toStatus}, current_auditor_id = #{currentAuditorId}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, reviewed_time = #{reviewedTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and application_status in #{s} and (current_auditor_id is null or current_auditor_id = #{auditorId})
update basket_player_cert_application set player_id = #{playerId}, normalized_game_account = #{normalizedGameAccount}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
